CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_Branch_DEP
AS
BEGIN
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Branch AS
(
	SELECT
		BDS.SOL_ID AS BranchId
		,BDS.SOL_DESC AS BranchName
		,NULL AS BranchTypeId
		,NULL AS ChannelId
		,BDS.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDS.INSTRMNT_ENCODE_BATCH_NUM AS InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber
		,BDS.INSTRMNT_ENCODE_BLOCK_NUM AS InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber
		,BDS.USER_CASH_DR_LIM_EXCP_CODE AS UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode
		,BDS.USER_XFER_DR_LIM_EXCP_CODE AS UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode
		,BDS.CUT_OVER_TIME AS CutOverTime
		,BDS.BR_STAT_CODE AS BranchStateCode
		,BDS.HC_VAULT_LIMIT_IN_HC AS HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
		,BDS.FC_VAULT_LIMIT_IN_HC AS ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
		,BDS.CONSOL_VAULT_LIMIT_IN_HC AS ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount
		,BDS.NUM_OF_TIMES_IBR_GEN AS IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator
		,BDS.OSP_MAX_OUT_STD_DAYS AS OspMaxOutStdDays
		,BDS.HOME_CRNCY_CODE AS HomeIsoCurrencyCode
		,BDS.DDN_WARN_LEVEL AS DdnWarnLevel
		,BDS.EXTERNAL_SOL AS ExternalBranchIndicator
		,BDS.FAB_FLG AS FabStatusId
		,BDS.BRANCH_REF_PORT_NUM AS BranchReferencePortNumber
		,BDS.SOL_CLS_FLG AS BranchClosedIndicator
		,BDS.REROUTE_STP_ALLOWED AS RerouteStpAllowedIndicator
		,BDS.SOL_RESTARTABILITY_FLG AS BranchRestartabilityId
		,BDS.MIN_AGE_OF_ACCT_OWNERSHIP_XFER AS MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
		,BDS.MAX_AGE_OF_ACCT_OWNERSHIP_XFER AS MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
		,BDS.RPT_TAX_YR_DDMM AS ReportingTaxYearDayMonth
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDS.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,NULL AS CategoryId
        ,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE_DELTA BDSD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE BDS
		ON BDSD.SOL_ID = BDS.SOL_ID
		AND BDSD.BANK_ID = BDS.BANK_ID
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Branch FROM TEMP_BNKM_Branch;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_Branch_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			BranchId
			,BranchName
			,BranchTypeId
			,ChannelId
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber
			,InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber
			,UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode
			,UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode
			,CutOverTime
			,BranchStateCode
			,HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
			,ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
			,ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount
			,IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator
			,OspMaxOutStdDays
			,HomeIsoCurrencyCode
			,DdnWarnLevel
			,ExternalBranchIndicator
			,FabStatusId
			,BranchReferencePortNumber
			,BranchClosedIndicator
			,RerouteStpAllowedIndicator
			,BranchRestartabilityId
			,MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
			,MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
			,ReportingTaxYearDayMonth
			,CategoryId)) AS HASHROW
			,BranchId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Branch WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_Branch_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			BranchId
			,BranchName
			,BranchTypeId
			,ChannelId
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber
			,InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber
			,UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode
			,UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode
			,CutOverTime
			,BranchStateCode
			,HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
			,ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
			,ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount
			,IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator
			,OspMaxOutStdDays
			,HomeIsoCurrencyCode
			,DdnWarnLevel
			,ExternalBranchIndicator
			,FabStatusId
			,BranchReferencePortNumber
			,BranchClosedIndicator
			,RerouteStpAllowedIndicator
			,BranchRestartabilityId
			,MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
			,MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
			,ReportingTaxYearDayMonth
			,CategoryId)) AS HASHROW
			,BranchId ,FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BNKM.Branch WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_Branch_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.BranchId,TGT.BranchId) AS BranchId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_Branch_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Branch_TGT TGT
		ON SRC.BranchId = TGT.BranchId
		AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Branch_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Branch_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
    BranchId = SRC.BranchId
    ,BranchName = SRC.BranchName
    ,BranchTypeId = SRC.BranchTypeId
    ,ChannelId = SRC.ChannelId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber = SRC.InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber
    ,InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber = SRC.InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber
    ,UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode = SRC.UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode
    ,UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode = SRC.UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode
    ,CutOverTime = SRC.CutOverTime
    ,BranchStateCode = SRC.BranchStateCode
    ,HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount = SRC.HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
    ,ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount = SRC.ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
    ,ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount = SRC.ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount
    ,IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator = SRC.IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator
    ,OspMaxOutStdDays = SRC.OspMaxOutStdDays
    ,HomeIsoCurrencyCode = SRC.HomeIsoCurrencyCode
    ,DdnWarnLevel = SRC.DdnWarnLevel
    ,ExternalBranchIndicator = SRC.ExternalBranchIndicator
    ,FabStatusId = SRC.FabStatusId
    ,BranchReferencePortNumber = SRC.BranchReferencePortNumber
    ,BranchClosedIndicator = SRC.BranchClosedIndicator
    ,RerouteStpAllowedIndicator = SRC.RerouteStpAllowedIndicator
    ,BranchRestartabilityId = SRC.BranchRestartabilityId
    ,MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer = SRC.MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
    ,MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer = SRC.MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
    ,ReportingTaxYearDayMonth = SRC.ReportingTaxYearDayMonth
    ,CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId = SRC.TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId = SRC.WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Branch TGT
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Branch_DELTA DELTA
    ON DELTA.BranchId = TGT.BranchId
	AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Branch SRC
    ON SRC.BranchId = TGT.BranchId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId

INSERT INTO BNKM.Branch
    (BranchId
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchTypeId
    ,ChannelId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber
    ,InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber
    ,UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode
    ,UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode
    ,CutOverTime
    ,BranchStateCode
    ,HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
    ,ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
    ,ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount
    ,IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator
    ,OspMaxOutStdDays
    ,HomeIsoCurrencyCode
    ,DdnWarnLevel
    ,ExternalBranchIndicator
    ,FabStatusId
    ,BranchReferencePortNumber
    ,BranchClosedIndicator
    ,RerouteStpAllowedIndicator
    ,BranchRestartabilityId
    ,MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
    ,MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
    ,ReportingTaxYearDayMonth
    ,CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT 
    BranchId
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchTypeId
    ,ChannelId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,InstrumentEncodeBatchNumber
    ,InstrumentEncodeBlockNumber
    ,UserCashDebitLimitExceptionCode
    ,UserTransferDebitLimitExceptionCode
    ,CutOverTime
    ,BranchStateCode
    ,HomeCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
    ,ForeignCurrencyVaultLimitAmount
    ,ConsolidatedVaultLimitAmount
    ,IBReconciliationGeneratedIndicator
    ,OspMaxOutStdDays
    ,HomeIsoCurrencyCode
    ,DdnWarnLevel
    ,ExternalBranchIndicator
    ,FabStatusId
    ,BranchReferencePortNumber
    ,BranchClosedIndicator
    ,RerouteStpAllowedIndicator
    ,BranchRestartabilityId
    ,MinimumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
    ,MaximumAgeOfAccountOwnershipTransfer
    ,ReportingTaxYearDayMonth
    ,CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Branch
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Branch;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Branch_DELTA;

END
